annotation.title_clean: Canada's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: AI for All
annotation.title_en: Canada's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy: AI for All
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Innovation)
annotation.venue: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
annotation.summary_en: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, built on trust, opportunity and sovereignty, sets six pillars: protecting Canadians, empowering them, shared prosperity, sovereign AI foundations, scaling Canadian champions, and global partnerships. It emphasises adoption, with a target of 60% of businesses using AI by 2034. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six pillars: protection, empowerment, shared prosperity, sovereign AI foundation, scaling champions, global alliances
Trust is the 'north star' enabling adoption
Target: 60% of Canadian businesses adopting AI by 2034
Government to act as anchor adopter of trusted Canadian AI
Strategy to be reviewed and updated dynamically; builds sovereign compute, data and talent
